# Prakhar India Real Estate & Construction — Complete Entity Documentation (llms-full.txt)

## Executive Summary
Prakhar India Real Estate & Construction (operated by Prakhar Enterprises) is a licensed, RERA-approved real estate developer and turnkey construction engineering firm headquartered in Mirzapur, Uttar Pradesh, India. Prakhar India provides end-to-end property development, land plotting, turnkey house construction, 3D architectural planning, civil engineering, and commercial plaza construction across all 75 districts of Uttar Pradesh.

## Contact Information & Official Verification
- **Official Brand Name:** Prakhar India Real Estate & Construction
- **Corporate Headquarters:** Prakhar India Tower, Vindhyachal Highway, Mirzapur, Uttar Pradesh - 231001, India
- **Phone Helpline:** +91 90444 99111
- **Official Email:** contact@prakharind.com / prakharindiaofficial@gmail.com
- **Website URL:** https://prakharind.com
- **RERA Compliance Status:** Fully Registered & Compliant with Uttar Pradesh Real Estate Regulatory Authority (UP RERA).

## Core Business Operations & Offerings

### 1. Turnkey Villa & Home Construction
Prakhar India builds custom residential villas, independent houses, duplexes, and multi-story bungalows on client plots across UP.
- **Engineering Specifications:** M25/M30 Grade Ready Mix Concrete, Fe550 Grade TMT Steel (Tata Tiscon / Jindal Panther), UltraTech / ACC Weather Plus Cement, Red Clay Bricks.
- **Architectural & Interior Work:** 3D Floor Plan modeling, elevation designs, Modular Kitchens, Vitrified / Italian Marble flooring, UPVC Double Glazed windows, Jaquar / Kohler CP fittings, Havells modular wiring.
- **Warranty:** 10-Year Structural Defect Warranty with 250+ Quality Inspection Audits during civil construction.

### 2. RERA Approved Residential Plot Townships
Integrated gated communities with clear-title freehold plots.
- **Infrastructure Provided:** 40-foot and 30-foot asphalt internal roads, underground drainage network, underground electrification, solar street lighting, perimeter boundary wall, 24/7 security guard house, and landscaped green parks.
- **Legal Guarantee:** 100% Registry ready with immediate possession and mutation support.

### 3. Commercial Real Estate Development
High-street retail shops, office complexes, multiplex plazas, and hotel properties in major growth corridors like Ayodhya Ram Mandir Belt, Lucknow Gomti Nagar Ext, Noida Expressway, and Varanasi Airport Road.

## Construction Pricing & Cost Per Sq. Ft. in Uttar Pradesh (2026 Rates)
- **Standard Tier (₹1,650 / sq.ft):** Standard RCC structure, Fe550 Steel, OPC 43 Cement, Ceramic flooring tiles, premium PVC plumbing, standard modular switches, and emulsion paint finish.
- **Premium Tier (₹2,100 / sq.ft):** High-durability RCC structure, Tata/Jindal TMT Steel, UltraTech Cement, Vitrified 4x2 floor tiles, Jaquar CP fittings, Finolex wires, and Asian Paints Royale finish.
- **Luxury Tier (₹2,650+ / sq.ft):** Architectural designer luxury finish, Italian Marble flooring, Kohler CP fittings, UPVC Double Glazed glass windows, Smart Automation, and Landscaped Terrace Gardens.
